body.message:
Hi Fam Living Team,
I hope this message finds you well.
I am the owner of a studio apartment in Society House, Downtown Dubai. I am very interested in exploring your management solutions for short and mid-term rentals.
I will be visiting Dubai soon and want to maximize my week on-site. To make the most of our time, I would like to align on a few preliminary details remotely and schedule a face-to-face meeting during my stay.
Best regards
